limitationItems.sample_data: The report uses sample data. The results do not describe this field.
limitationItems.meteo_missing: Weather data is missing, so the water balance cannot be calculated.
limitationItems.meteo_coarse_grid: Weather comes from a grid with cells tens of kilometres wide. Local storms may not match.
limitationItems.soil_estimated: The soil type is estimated from maps, not measured on the field.
limitationItems.soil_missing: Soil data is missing. We assumed a typical soil for the area.
limitationItems.terrain_missing: The terrain model is missing, so we do not assess runoff.
limitationItems.terrain_coarse: The terrain model is coarse. Small dips may not be visible.
limitationItems.hydro_missing: Data on ditches and streams nearby is missing.
limitationItems.vegetation_missing: There are no cloud-free satellite images from this period.
limitationItems.vegetation_few_pixels: The field is small or narrow, so the satellite image covers few points.
limitationItems.vegetation_before_archive: There are no comparable satellite images for such an old date.
limitationItems.forecast_missing: The weather forecast is missing, so we do not suggest when to water.
limitationItems.out_of_season: This day is outside the agricultural drought season (21 March – 30 September).
limitationItems.crop_not_monitored: There are no official drought thresholds for this crop. The assessment is based on the soil water reserve.
limitationItems.balance_estimated: We calculate the water balance with our own method, so it may differ from IUNG reports.
limitationItems.current_boundaries: The parcel boundaries are current. They may have been different on the analysis day.
limitationItems.no_in_situ_measurement: Nobody measured soil moisture on site. These are calculations from remote data.
limitationItems.field_verification_needed: Before deciding, check the soil on the field, e.g. with a spade at root depth.
limitationItems.sample_data_partial: Some of the data is still sample data (the box at the top of the report says which). Treat those parts as illustrative.
limitationItems.drainage_structures_unknown: Maps do not show weirs or culverts on ditches. Before planning a ditch weir, check on site what is already on the ditch.
limitationItems.vegetation_rotation_unknown: We compare satellite images with the same time of year in previous years, but we do not know what grew on the field then (crop rotation).
limitationItems.soil_lighter_by_registry: The soil map shows heavier soil here, while the land register gives a weak class (V–VI). We assumed light soil, following the register – check in the field, e.g. with a spade.
limitationItems.soil_heavier_by_registry: The soil map shows very light soil here, while the land register gives a good class (I–II). We assumed medium soil, following the register – check in the field.
limitationItems.likely_forest: According to the topographic map (BDOT10k) more than half of this parcel is forest or woodland. We give no field measures or irrigation advice.
limitationItems.likely_not_farmland: The soil map has no soil here (usually buildings or water). We give no field measures or irrigation advice.
limitationItems.land_use_unknown: The land register did not say what this parcel is. We treat it as a field – check the aerial photo to make sure it is not forest or buildings.

simple.title: Short analysis
simple.waterEmpty: We have no soil water balance for this day, so we do not show the reserve or the forecast. The assessment and history are below.
simple.historyTitle: 10 years on this field and why
simple.weatherTo: Weather measured up to {date}, later days calculated without rain.

scale.label: On the scale from wet to very dry: {step}.

verdict.excess: In the last {days} days {sum} l/m² of rain fell – usually about {median} l/m².
verdict.resting: The soil holds {percent}% of the water plants can take.
verdict.ok: The soil water tank is {percent}% full.
verdict.missing: About {mm} l/m² of water is missing – the soil tank is only {percent}% full.

lines.historyText: Water was short in {dry} of {total} seasons.
lines.historyMonths: Water was short in {dry} of {total} seasons, most often: {months}.

causes.title: Why water is short
causes.titleRisk: What makes this field prone to drought

limits.title: What to keep in mind about this assessment
limits.advice: Talk to an agricultural adviser before investing (a weir, irrigation).

offSeason.now: Plants are not growing now, and agricultural drought is assessed from 21 March to 30 September. We show how much water the soil holds for spring, how often drought returned in 10 years and what to do before the season.
offSeason.summer: See how it was in summer ({date})

tank.title: How much water do the plants have now?
tank.answerOk: The tank is {percent}% full – plants take water without effort.
tank.answerStressed: The tank is only {percent}% full – below the threshold, plants drink from the last reserve and grow slower.
tank.answerResting: The soil holds {percent}% of the water plants can take. The crop is not growing now, so we do not count the drought threshold.
tank.source: Root-zone water balance (FAO-56) from weather and soil maps – a model, not a field measurement.
tank.description: Water available to plants: {percent}% of the tank, {mm} of {capacity} l/m².

countdown.title: How many days until the crop stops growing?
countdown.stressedTitle: For how many days have the plants been short of water?
countdown.lead: days without rain before the plants start to suffer
countdown.unit: {days, plural, one {day of reserve} other {days of reserve}}
countdown.answer: Without rain the reserve drops below the threshold in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
countdown.answerForecast: Without rain the reserve drops below the threshold in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, with the forecast rain – in {withRain, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
countdown.beyondAnswer: The water reserve will last more than {days} days even without rain.
countdown.stressedUnit: {days, plural, one {day in a row} other {days in a row}}
countdown.stressedAnswer: The soil water reserve is below the threshold – plants grow slower and the yield may drop.
countdown.until: Without rain the water lasts until {lastDay}, {lastDate}. From {thresholdDay} the plants will start to suffer.
countdown.withForecast: With the forecast rain the reserve lasts {withRain, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
countdown.source: Crop water use from the average evaporation of the last 7 days (FAO-56); the forecast variant uses the forecast rain.

forecast.title: Will this week bring relief?
forecast.answer: In the next {days} days about {total} l/m² of rain will fall, most on {day} ({max} l/m²).
forecast.answerDry: Almost no rain in the next {days} days.
forecast.tooLittle: That is too little to refill the soil (about {missing} l/m² missing).
forecast.legend: Top row: highest temperature, bottom: rain in l/m² (= mm).

ledger.title: Where did the water go since spring?
ledger.answerMore: Plants and sun took {ratio} times more water than the rain brought.
ledger.answerLess: More rain fell than the plants used – the soil reserve recovered.
ledger.answerEven: About as much rain fell as the plants used.
ledger.answerNoRain: No rain fell, and the plants used {use} l/m² from the reserve.
ledger.source: Root-zone water balance (FAO-56). The model does not count surface runoff.
ledger.missingDays: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} without weather data are counted without rain.
ledger.unit: Numbers in l/m² (= mm). “Plants were short” – how much more water they needed than they had.

seasons.title: How was it over 10 years?
seasons.headline: {dry} of {total}
seasons.headlineNote: previous seasons when the crop was clearly short of water
seasons.answer: Water was clearly short in {dry} of {total} previous seasons.
seasons.answerMonths: Water was clearly short in {dry} of {total} previous seasons – most often: {months}.
seasons.source: Bars: days short of water from the root-zone balance – a few such days happen every year. A season counts as dry when the crop was short of at least 50 l/m² of water or there was an agricultural drought period by IUNG thresholds.
seasons.barDescription: {year}: {days} days short of water{drought, select, yes {, agricultural drought} other {}}
seasons.legendCurrent: current season up to the analysis day

rainUse.title: How much rain fell and how much did the plants drink?
rainUse.answer: In the last {days} days {rain} l/m² of rain fell, while the crop needed {use} l/m².
rainUse.source: Rain from weather data; crop needs = evaporation × crop coefficient (FAO-56).
rainUse.gaps: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} without rain data (empty column) – a gap in the data, not a day without rain.
rainUse.answerGaps: In the last {days} days at least {rain} l/m² of rain fell (no data yet for {gaps, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}), while the crop needed {use} l/m².

vegetation.title: What does the satellite see?

position.below: That is below the range of {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} at this time ({min} – {max}) – plants have less water than usual.
position.within: That is within the range of {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} at this time ({min} – {max}).
position.above: That is above the range of {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} at this time ({min} – {max}).

vegetation.answerNone: Clouds covered the field on all images from this period – the satellite shows nothing.
vegetation.source: Sentinel-2 images (Copernicus), plant moisture index NDMI for the whole field.
vegetation.counts: Images used: {used}, skipped because of clouds: {skipped}.
vegetation.band: Grey band – range from the previous {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}, dashed line – middle.
vegetation.window: Images from the 30 days before the analysis day ({from} – {to}), not the whole season.

shares.title: Share of causes
shares.note: An estimate of each cause's weight in explaining the result, not a measure of how much water it took.

numbers.balanceThreshold: drought threshold for soil cat. {category}: {threshold} mm{below, select, yes { – exceeded} other {}}
numbers.balanceNoThreshold: the crop has no drought threshold in this period
numbers.ndmiRange: usually at this time {min} – {max} (from {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}})
numbers.ndmiAnomaly: {anomaly} against this time in {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}
numbers.dryDays: Days in a row without rain
numbers.dryReference: rain on {rainy} of the last {days} days (≥ 1 mm)

satellite.title: Field from satellite
satellite.noParcels: We do not show satellite images for a field drawn without cadastral parcels – images are fetched for whole parcels.
satellite.notLoaded: Satellite images of the field were not loaded. To include them in the PDF, use the “Save PDF” button in the report.
satellite.intro: Two images of the parcel from one satellite picture taken before the analysis day. They show where plants do better or worse – and where they hold more water.
satellite.loading: Fetching the satellite image… The first time this takes up to a dozen seconds or so.
satellite.clouds: Part of the field was under cloud that day – it has no colour there.

problem.noClearScene: No clear satellite image: for 30 days before {date} the field was under cloud or snow.
problem.notConfigured: Satellite images are not enabled on this server – the rest of the report is complete.
problem.busy: The satellite image service (Copernicus) is not responding right now. Try again in a moment.
problem.failed: Could not fetch the satellite image – the rest of the report is complete.

condition.title: Crop condition
condition.what: Greenness and density of plants: red spots grow worse, green ones better.
condition.alt: Crop condition on the parcel – satellite image with the field outline
condition.advisor: For advisers: NDVI from Sentinel-2 (bands B04 and B08, 10 m pixel), scale {low}–{high}.

moisture.title: Water in plants
moisture.what: How much water plants hold: brown spots are drier, blue ones wetter.
moisture.alt: Water in plants on the parcel – satellite image with the field outline
moisture.advisor: For advisers: NDMI from Sentinel-2 (bands B8A and B11, 20 m pixel), scale {low}–{high}.

limits.pixel: One square is 10–20 m on the ground, so a small parcel shows only a few dozen squares.
limits.oneDay: This is a picture from one day – after rain, heat or mowing it will look different.
limits.plantsNotSoil: “Water in plants” is the moisture of plants, not of the soil.
limits.relative: Colours compare places within the field, not fields with each other.
limits.colour: Colours need colour printing – in black and white both ends of the scale look alike.
